shape: three claims, three axes (operability, calibration, freshness), no exploratory claim

C1.sentence: At the landing revision corpus/evidence/round90/control-driver-r90.py verify --root . --repo . --rev <freeze> --receipts-rev <receipts-carrier> prints CONTROL_DRIVER_R90=PASS (exit 0) with COMMITTED_OK=6/6 EXACT_OK=6/6 PIN_OK=6/6 FRESH_OK=6/6 over the six committed receipts; each receipt is read before any fresh run, # exit= equals the row exit, every required K=V equals one whole body token (a differing token with the same key is TOKEN_DETACHED), every key>=N predicate holds (harm records>=1), a key repeated with different values is DUPLICATE_KEY, # computed_against= equals --rev with the scoring bytes byte-identical at their carrier revisions, and the re-run agrees with the committed receipt; and corpus/evidence/round90/control-forgeries-r90.py prints FORGERY_REFUSED=6/6 PRIOR_ACCEPTED=6/6 POSITIVE=pass, each forgery refused by r90 and accepted by the unchanged r89 driver on the same fixture.

kill_rules.K1: predicate not met at the landing revision
kill_rules.K2: a forgery accepted by r90, the positive refused, or the r89 driver refuses a forgery
kill_rules.K3: a genuine row moved or silently rewritten by the verification path (FINDING on the committed set, or a receipts-dir write)
kill_rules.K4: the pass skips the work: missing receipt accepted, committed receipt not read, substring token match, or the pin minted in verify

named_limits: a coherent joint edit of instrument, receipt and expectation row survives (that edit is the harness)
whole-token matching binds one field per token, not its semantic role
the self-pin detects a moved byte inside a named commit, not a rewritten history

kill_rules.K1: predicate not met at the landing revision
kill_rules.K2: a listed mutant survives, the positive mirror is refused, or a tree forgery is accepted
kill_rules.K3: harm: a curated entry's verdict moves, or the registry diff exceeds the S220 row plus its used-by cell
kill_rules.K4: the verdict or witness is satisfied by constants rather than the detector bodies

named_limits: MIN_TOKENS=7 is a measured floor, not a content check
the qid-set pin guards label identity, not quote content
the witness tests each detector function on synthetic strings; a caller that bypasses the function is not witnessed
the superseder-own-read clause is vacuous on the real registry (SUP_CLAUSE_CHECKED=0); the battery mirror carries non-vacuity

kill_rules.K1: predicate not met at the landing revision
kill_rules.K2: the check passes with no tally row, or matches against a stale number instead of the tool's live verdict
